Noticed a recent spike in calls from BrightPath's sandbox over the last 48 hours (nice work!). Our signals flagged a usage pulse that often maps to teams trying a short integration or running a tight inference loop — both great reasons to sync.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute intro so we can:
- surface any immediate optimizations (batching/caching) to reduce token costs,
- run a quick troubleshooting checklist if you saw higher latency, and
- cover the minimal rollout path if you want predictable throughput?

If yes, Ben (cc'd) will drop a few slots — or here's a Calendly if you prefer to pick: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min

- Today 11:00–11:15

- Tomorrow 09:30–09:45

Short agenda attached. No heavy prep required — just bring your sample request shape or a brief note on which endpoint you call most.

Thanks!
